sentences.en: For him to trust you, you have to appear vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 对他来说要信任你，就必须显得脆弱。

sentences.en: Mennad didn't want to show a vulnerable part of him.
sentences.zh: 梅纳德不想暴露自己脆弱的一面。

sentences.en: Koalas are vulnerable to bushfires due to their slow movements.
sentences.zh: 由于行动缓慢，考拉容易在山火中受伤。

senses.zh: 有弱点的；易受伤害的；易受攻击的，易受…的攻击
